metrics.label: Memory while serving and tailing
metrics.source: Anonymous memory (RssAnon) of the kda-indexer service, sampled once a minute during the final validation, validation host (8 vCPU AMD EPYC, 24 GiB RAM, virtual block storage) shared with chainweb-node 3.2.1 and chainweb-data; chainweb-data container memory from docker stats at the same time (2026-11-17 17:01Z).
metrics.note: Regression, and not like for like: ours is process heap, chainweb-data's is its container (Haskell + Postgres) as docker reports it. Ours held flat at about 1.16 GB for 20 h while serving the harness and GraphQL; it also maps about 8 GB of segment files as page cache the kernel can reclaim.
